name: KOREA ELECTRIC POWER CORPORATION
share_adj_basis: applied to revenue components only (v5.4); OE/share CAGR enters unadjusted

ads_ratio.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-29, accession 0001193125-26-190113), cover page: 'American depositary shares, each representing one-half of share of common stock'; Item 9.A Share Capital repeats: 'One ADS represents one-half of one share of our common stock.'
ads_ratio.reason: EDGAR diluted share counts are in ordinary shares while the Nasdaq/NYSE price is per ADS; each ADS represents one-half of one ordinary share, so per-share figures must be scaled x0.5 ordinary shares per ADS to be comparable to the ADS price.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

f_subtype_basis: sum of the last 3 fiscal years (the median window)

overrides_applied.source: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-29, accession 0001193125-26-190113), Item 16G / NYSE-standards comparison, 'Shareholder Approval of Equity Compensation Plans': 'We currently do not have any equity compensation plans.' The term 'share-based' appears nowhere in the 20-F, and EDGAR companyfacts carries no ifrs-full AdjustmentsForSharebasedPayments / ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactionsWithEmployees (or us-gaap ShareBasedCompensation) fact for this filer in any year.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for fiscal years 2022, 2023, 2024 of the last 3 under every tag the engine reads. KEPCO has no equity-settled share-based payment expense to subtract: it has no equity compensation plans, so there is no equity SBC cost inside or outside operating cash flow. The filing-sourced figure for equity SBC in the gap years is 0 (same treatment as SQM, TS and LTM in this sweep).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 22 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency KRW converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x0.5 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-29, accession 0001193125-26-190113), cover page: 'American depositary shares, each representing one-half of share of common stock'; Item 9.A Share Capital repeats: 'One ADS represents one-half of one share of our common stock.') so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Utilities sector — OE/capex DCF fits utilities names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-29, accession 0001193125-26-190113), Item 16G / NYSE-standards comparison, 'Shareholder Approval of Equity Compensation Plans': 'We currently do not have any equity compensation plans.' The term 'share-based' appears nowhere in the 20-F, and EDGAR companyfacts carries no ifrs-full AdjustmentsForSharebasedPayments / ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactionsWithEmployees (or us-gaap ShareBasedCompensation) fact for this filer in any year.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass. F sub-type: no cash generation (OCF - capex is not positive).

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
